input: We run a three-person web agency serving independent fitness studios in the UK. Decide which productized service we should launch next. Produce a ranked shortlist of five options with a one-page rationale for the top choice. Success means the offer can reach £8,000 in monthly recurring revenue within six months, can be delivered by our current team, and needs no more than £1,500 in new software. We have strong TypeScript, design, paid-search, and client-interview skills, plus access to 12 studio owners. Avoid services that require regulated health advice, a mobile app, or 24/7 support. Use current market examples and direct customer pain evidence. We need the recommendation by 30 September 2026 and can spend two weeks researching it.
